preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**9 and 1 <= a <= 10**9 and 1 <= b <= 10**9 for n, a, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case has n, a, b between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == ('Yes' if is_in_set(n, a, b) else 'No') for i, (n, a, b) in enumerate(test_cases))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'Yes' if n is in the set generated by a and b, otherwise 'No'.
